answer: Sequential challenge settlement. Each agent identity must solve a unique, state-dependent puzzle whose seed includes the prior solver's answer, so the chain advances only when responses are unrepeatable. A copy of an earlier solution fails verification, and precomputation stalls at the glacier pace of sequential dependency. Attackers must run full compute per identity and hold a knoll of verified history before their first payout, making mass creation cost linearly prohibitive. Every reuse of a fable answer is rejected outright.
